analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 12, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Rating changes: Magazine Luiza (MGLU3.SA) upgraded to Buy from Neutral, target R$11.50 from R$6.30, 50% upside from R$7.66, on potential market share gains.

Rating changes: Tikehau Capital (TKOO.PA) and Partners Group (PGHN.S) both cut to Sell from Neutral in a more selective view on European alternative asset managers. Tikehau target EUR16.00 from EUR19.40, Partners Group target SFr610 from SFr770.
The Block (XYZ) Builderlab product event takeaways are flagged as a call to focus on today, with the stock listed as Buy on the Conviction List (CL).

Americas Energy: Permian Basin takeaways highlight Buys on PR for FCF per share growth and on FANG for organic Midland asset value. A separate note highlights favorable risk/reward in ConocoPhillips (Buy) on a differentiated FCF growth story.

Talen Energy (TLN, Buy): 3Q callback says contracting momentum adds confidence to the FCF outlook. A separate note covers PJM capacity agreements on gas plants, 2+ GW near term and 750 MW longer term.

US Economics Analyst (Rindels) covers the 2027 capex outlook and how much of an AI boost it provides. Global Economics Comment (Peters) asks whether more upside inflation surprises should be expected.
Americas Utilities: EEI conference takeaways describe a constructive tone despite investor concern after the midterms.
Venture Global (VG): management meeting after 3Q26 cites strong CP2 news, a clear funding bridge and a solid power update.
Kodiak Gas Services (KGS): 3Q26 recap shows a strong compression update, with power news lighter, as expected, ahead of 1Q27 contracts.

Oddity Tech (ODD): Q3 better than feared with an FY26 guidance raise, but visibility into a recovery and return to growth remains limited. Sell maintained, target $10 from $9, 50% downside from $19.90.
Suja Life (SUJA) downgraded to Neutral after pressured Q3 results, lowered FY26 guidance, and FY27 growth likely below algorithm. Target $12 from $27.
Grocery Outlet (GO): better same-store sales offset by higher costs and lower store growth. Sell, target $8 from $6, 39% downside from $13.12.
Block Inc. (XYZ) event, and Western Union (WU): WU delivered notice to terminate the merger agreement and IMXI rejects.
BrightView (BV): F4Q miss and development volatility overshadow Land momentum. Sell, target $8.70 from $10.00.
TransDigm (TDG): fundamentals strong, valuation attractive, Buy.
Teva (TEVA): R&D Day frames a compelling long-term growth outlook.
Europe Retail: On continues to perform strongly in a promotional market but turns negative in China. Chinese aggregator growth deteriorates further in Europe.

European earnings: Siemens AG strong 4Q beat and guide ahead to drive low-single-digit FY2027 EPS consensus up. Siemens Energy sees higher growth and returns with scope for further upgrades. Merck KGaA solid 3Q beat with guidance raise. Sonova H1 EBIT beat of about 10% with FY27 guidance raised. Hapag-Lloyd Q3 below expectations, FY outlook ahead.
China Banks and China Insurance: media reports of a possible tax on interest income from government bond coupons, with GS assessing the impact. Ageas also flagged on the same report.
China CRO and CDMO: 3Q26 wrap-up says robust orders reinforce 2027 visibility despite recent market volatility. China Healthcare prefers CDMO into 2027.
China Consumer and Cosmetics: muted demand with deleverage and cost pressure on margins, and a muted Double 11 for cosmetics, with Mao Geping leading.

Japan: Recruit (6098.T) 2Q above consensus, GSe and TP raised, Buy. Daifuku 3Q OP below expectations but orders above, TP trimmed, Buy. Nippon Paint Q3 beat, Buy. Square Enix 2Q beat but Sell maintained on valuation.

Brazil: AGI Inc. (AGBK) 3Q26 shows growth momentum building. Brazil Energy sees dividend yield up to 20% at USD 75/bbl Brent in 2027 for PBR and PRIO. Brazil Utilities power price monitor says hydrology continues to surprise to the upside and GS is below consensus for 4Q26/2027.
Global Metals and Mining estimates near US$10bn of value leakage over 10 years from CMRG iron ore discounts.
Index Strategy: MSCI Global Investable Market Indexes November 2026 review and flow implications published.
Credit Notes: EUR credit and elections seen as a likely short-lived headwind for financials.

earnings_insights: Oddity Tech (ODD) Q3 reported better than feared with FY26 guidance raised. Visibility into a recovery and return to growth remains limited, Sell maintained.
Suja Life (SUJA) Q3 reported pressured, FY26 guidance lowered, FY27 growth seen below algorithm.

Sonova reported H1 FY27 EBIT about 10% above expectations, and raised FY27 top and bottom line guidance.
Hapag-Lloyd reported Q3 below expectations, with FY outlook ahead.
